abstract: In short, the comparison of the arms gives these main findings. Overall, Alvenor increases side effects compared with Standard care. Overall, Alvenor lowers systolic drop compared with Standard care.
conclusion: Taken together, the arms compare as follows. Overall, Alvenor increases side effects compared with Standard care. Overall, Alvenor lowers systolic drop compared with Standard care.
section:
### A further comparison between arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Alvenor is a once daily tablet that relaxes the walls of the blood vessels. All data for this comparison were collected at the Oakfield Family Cohort.

Table 3. Counts and means for every group, measure and subset.

| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Standard care | Side effects | 145 | 500 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Alvenor | Side effects | 201 | 500 |

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Mean | SD | n |
